enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Sleep. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Sleep. Turn to back. Sleep. Wake briefly. Turn to left side. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up on bed. Swing legs off bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste onto toothbrush. Brush teeth. Spit into sink. Rinse mouth with water. Put down toothbrush. Wash face with water. Pick up towel. Dry face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating a quick breakfast, boiling water with the kettle and toasting bread
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out bread and butter. Close refrigerator. Place bread slice in toaster. Press toaster lever down. Fill kettle with water. Plug in kettle. Turn on kettle. Wait for toast. Toast pops up. Remove toast from toaster. Place toast on plate. Spread butter on toast. Eat toast. Drink water from glass. Put plate in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the morning shift
enriched_activities.desc: Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Open front door. Step outside. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus arrives at hospital stop. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to hospital entrance.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, attending to patients and clinical duties at the hospital
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Change into scrubs. Attend handover meeting. Receive patient assignments. Check patient charts. Visit patient rooms. Take vital signs. Administer medications. Assist doctors with procedures. Update patient records. Wash hands. Take lunch break. Eat lunch in cafeteria. Return to ward. Continue patient care. Attend afternoon meeting. Complete paperwork. End shift.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap transit card. Sit down. Look out window. Bus arrives at stop. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk home. Open front door. Enter home. Lock door.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and changing out of work clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Remove work clothes. Place clothes in laundry basket. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wash body. Rinse body. Apply shampoo. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Put on home clothes.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner with the induction cooker and eating
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Place pot on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off induction cooker. Serve food onto plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up plates. Scrape leftovers into trash. Rinse plates. Open dishwasher. Load plates into dishwasher. Load utensils. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Press start button. Wipe table with cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV and browsing the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open social media app. Scroll through feed. Like a post. Comment on a post. Lock phone. Put down phone. Watch TV. Pick up phone again. Browse news. Lock phone. Put down phone. Watch TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening hygiene routine, washing up before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Spit into sink. Rinse mouth. Put down toothbrush. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Wash hands. Dry hands. Turn off tap. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer and reading quietly under the desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Sit at desk. Open laptop. Press power button. Enter password. Open document. Type on keyboard. Use mouse. Save document. Close laptop. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Close book. Turn off desk lamp.

Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Sleep. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Sleep. Turn to back. Sleep.
